findings.quote: Every re-transmit stamp after that was Buoy 47 again.
findings.rule_broken: Custodial sea buoys run a 30-day bundle cache and bundles 'survive in buoy memory until delivered or expired' — an unacknowledged bundle held and re-transmitted by the same single buoy for nine straight years exceeds the buoy's declared 30-day cache and never expires as the tech spec requires.
findings.fix: Either route the bundle through successive buoy/satellite hops over the nine years, or have the buoy's cache reset/re-ingest the bundle, rather than one buoy holding and re-stamping it continuously for nine years past its 30-day cache limit.

iterations.note: Re-scored by a FRESH science-critic context, not by resuming the critic that proposed the fix. A critic grading its own suggestion is a weaker gate.
